summary:
American Express is the card issuer at americanexpress.com. The blue box in the tab is the favicon account bookmarks use, saved from the host response.

Checked 12 November 2026 against americanexpress.com. HTML came from https://www.americanexpress.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.americanexpress.com/favicon.ico.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.americanexpress.com/favicon.ico returned png (32×32, 1358 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: webp, png.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.americanexpress.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 152×152 webp.

Brand colour #0066cc comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-32x32-02.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: webp-152x152-01.webp at 152×152 (webp, 1964 bytes) from https://www.americanexpress.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
